* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Southwestern Pottawattamie County in southwestern Iowa...
Douglas County in east central Nebraska...
Northeastern Sarpy County in east central Nebraska...

* WHEN...Until 700 AM CDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Ponding of water in urban or other areas is occurring or is
imminent.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 326 AM CDT, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated
heavy rain due to thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or
expected to begin shortly in the advisory area. Between 1 and 3
inches of rain have fallen.

the area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Omaha, Council Bluffs, Bellevue, Papillion, Ralston, Bennington,
Boys Town, Elkhorn, Millard, La Vista, Carter Lake, Waterloo,
Crescent, Benson, Aksarben, Midtown, South Omaha, Florence,

events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues.

* WHERE...Berkeley County in southeastern South Carolina...
Charleston County in southeastern South Carolina...

* WHEN...Until 545 AM EDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Overflowing poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 358 AM EDT, Doppler radar indicated brands of showers and a
few thunderstorms with torrential rainfall moving onshore across
much of eastern Berkeley County and upper Charleston County. Up
to 1 to 2 inches of rain have already fallen in some areas and an
additional 1 to 2 inches could fall through 530 AM. The risk for
minor flooding of low-lying and poor drainage areas continues.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Mount Pleasant, McClellanville, Isle Of Palms, Sullivan's Island,
Awendaw, Jamestown, Garris Landing, Bull Island, Price Inlet and
Hampton Plantation State Park.
